tools.name: balance
tools.title: Read the prepaid balance
tools.description: The workspace's prepaid balance, what running jobs have set aside, spending today and this month (for the Owner), any daily cap on this connection's key, and the top-up link. Use it when a run is refused for funds or before a large job. Free. NOT for: the price of one run, which is capability_inspect.

tools.name: capability_inspect
tools.title: Read and price an action
tools.description: One action by its id: its inputs, what it gives and its price rule. With arguments (the person's real inputs) it also prices that exact run: the most it can cost, what it usually costs, the balance, and a consent sentence to read to the person. Nothing runs and nothing is charged. With rows or rows_text (up to 100, for people.email.find or companies.register.search or companies.emails.from_website) it prices a whole list. Use it before every paid run. For builders: endpoint_ids or exclude_endpoint_ids add the provider list those take. Free. NOT for: finding the id, which is capability_search, or running, which is run_capability.

id.description: An action id or tool id from capability_search.

arguments.description: Optional: the run's inputs, by name, to price that exact run (a quote only; nothing runs).

max_items.description: With arguments: most rows to price for, 1-100. Default 10.

timeout_seconds.description: With arguments: longest the run may take, 1-180 seconds. Default: the provider's own (60, more for slow sources).

endpoint_ids.description: With arguments: price the run on these providers only (endpoint ids from this answer).

exclude_endpoint_ids.description: With arguments: price the run without these providers.

rows.description: A list for people.email.find or companies.register.search or companies.emails.from_website: 1 to 100 rows, each run once as its own run with its own exact cost. One object per row, such as {"name": "Jane Doe", "domain": "example.com"} or {"name": "Example Ltd", "country": "GB"}.

rows_text.description: A list for people.email.find or companies.register.search or companies.emails.from_website: 1 to 100 rows, each run once as its own run with its own exact cost. Instead of rows: paste up to 100 rows as text, one per line ("Jane Doe, example.com"; "Example Ltd, GB") or a CSV with a header row (name, domain, linkedin_url; name, country).

tools.name: capability_run_status
tools.title: Read a run
tools.description: Read a run that was still going: give execution_id from run_capability and results true for its rows. Answers the result in plain words, the charge and the rows; an answer with rows has results_page and csv_url: give the person those links instead of writing the rows out again. Long results answer a next_offset. include_raw true adds the full record and the provider's own answer, for debugging. Free. NOT for: finding an action, which is capability_search.

include_raw.description: With results: also include the winning provider's own answer (raw) and the normalised output. Large and repeats the rows; leave it out unless the rows lack a field you need.

offset.description: With results: the first row to answer (0-based), from next_offset when a long result did not fit in one answer. Default 0.

full_text.description: With results: answer long text values whole. By default a result of several rows cuts each text value at 4000 characters and lists the cut fields in that row's truncated_fields.

max_items.description: With results: the max_items the run was started with, so the answer can say when the rows stopped at that limit. run_capability's next names it.

tools.name: capability_search
tools.title: Find an action
tools.description: Find the action for a job, by the person's own words ("work email of a person", "dentists in a city") or by an action id. Use it first for any one-off data job. When a ready-made recipe fits the ask, the answer offers it first. Each result has its id, what it gives, whether it is ready and its price rule. Nothing fits: the answer says so and catalog_request asks Ahel to add it. Free; changes nothing. NOT for: the exact price of one run, which is capability_inspect.

query.description: The job in the person's own words, or an exact action id such as companies.enrich.

platform.description: Optional platform id (companies, google, image-gen): only its items; with no query, its whole shelf.

kind.description: Optional: only actions (the value "task") or only provider tools.

status.description: Optional: only items in this state. Without it, only items that run now.

tools.name: catalog_request
tools.title: Ask for a missing action
tools.description: Ask Ahel to add an action the catalog does not have, when capability_search finds nothing that fits. Give the job in plain words, one example input, and the most the person would pay for one run. Asking again adds to the same request. Free; runs and charges nothing. NOT for: finding what exists, which is capability_search.

what.description: What you need done, in plain words: the job, not a provider name.

example_input.description: Optional: one example input, as text or an object (a domain, a profile URL, a name).

max_price_usd.description: Optional: the most you would pay for one call, in USD.

tools.name: feedback
tools.title: Rate a run or report a problem
tools.description: Tell Ahel what went wrong or right: rate one run or request good or bad by its id, or with no id report anything confusing (results, charges, instructions, errors, a workaround you needed). Report small annoyances too. Leave out private information and keys. Free. NOT for: reading a run, which is capability_run_status, or asking for a missing action, which is catalog_request.

id.description: To rate one: an execution id from run_capability, or a request id from catalog_request.

category.description: With no id: quality (results), pricing (charges or prices), friction (using Ahel) or other.

note.description: What was right or wrong, in a sentence or two. Required with no id.

tools.name: get_started
tools.title: Get started with Ahel
tools.description: Start here when the person is new, asks what Ahel can do, or has no clear job yet. Answers what Ahel does in plain words, the ready-made recipes to offer first, how paying works, and a question to ask the person. Free; changes nothing. NOT for: a clear one-off job, which is capability_search.

tools.name: review
tools.title: Review a run's usefulness
tools.description: Rate how useful one finished run was, after using its result: useful, partly, not_useful or not_sure, with an optional reason (missing rows, wrong data, stale). Reviewing again replaces the earlier one. Free. NOT for: reporting a problem, which is feedback.

reason.description: Optional: why, in a sentence or two, about the result.

tools.name: run_batch
tools.title: Run one action over many inputs
tools.description: Run one action over many inputs in one call (1 to 100 items, each the action's inputs), such as a company lookup for 20 domains. Priced the same per item as a single run, with no fee for batching, and only delivered results are charged; max_cost_usd caps the whole batch. Price one item with capability_inspect first and tell the person the total before running. The answer comes within about 45 seconds with each item's state, rows and charge; an item with rows has results_page and csv_url: give the person those links instead of writing the rows out again; items not finished by then finish when the same call is sent again (nothing runs or is charged twice). NOT for: one run, which is run_capability, or a ready-made job, which is run_recipe.

id.description: An action id or tool id from capability_search or capability_inspect. One action for the whole batch.

items.description: 1 to 100 objects, each the action's inputs for one run, by name, as run_capability's arguments.

max_items.description: Most rows each item collects, 1-100. Default 10.

max_cost_usd.description: Optional: the most the whole batch may cost, in USD, such as "2.50". Without it the workspace's normal limits apply.

idempotency_key.description: Optional: your own key for this batch, 8 to 200 letters, digits, dots, underscores, colons or hyphens. The same key and item answers the same run with no new charge; a new key runs it again. Left out, the same call the same UTC day is the same batch.

tag.description: Optional: a label for every run in this batch, such as the customer or project it is for: 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores. Activity shows runs and cost by tag. It stays in Ahel and is never sent to a provider.

tools.name: run_capability
tools.title: Run an action
tools.description: Run one action, after the person agreed to the price capability_inspect gave. Give id, arguments and max_cost_usd from that price: a run that would cost more is refused with nothing charged. Only a delivered result is charged; a run that finds nothing costs nothing. It waits up to wait_seconds (default 20, at most 50; 0 answers at once) and answers the result in plain words with its rows; a longer run answers its execution_id for capability_run_status. An answer with rows has results_page and csv_url: give the person those links instead of writing the rows out again. idempotency_key makes a retry safe (the same key answers the same run, no new charge). Give tag (such as a customer name) to see usage and cost by tag in Activity. A list for people.email.find or companies.register.search or companies.emails.from_website: rows, or rows_text (paste up to 100 rows as text), instead of arguments; without confirm it answers the price of the list, with confirm true it runs it. NOT for: the same action over many inputs, which is run_batch, or a ready-made job, which is run_recipe.

id.description: An action id or tool id from capability_search or capability_inspect.

capability_id.description: Instead of id: a v2 capability id from capability_run_status (no execution_id).

arguments.description: The capability's inputs, by name. Required unless rows, rows_text or run_id is given; with a list, {"verify": true} checks every found email.

timeout_seconds.description: Longest the run may take, 1-180 seconds. Default: the provider's own (60, more for slow sources).

endpoint_ids.description: Optional, for builders: run only on these providers, by the endpoint ids capability_inspect lists when given endpoint ids. Leave it out to let Ahel pick (the default).

exclude_endpoint_ids.description: Optional, for builders: never use these providers, by the endpoint ids capability_inspect lists when given endpoint ids. Ahel picks among the rest.

max_cost_usd.description: Optional: the most this run may cost, in USD, such as "0.05". capability_inspect's next names the quoted maximum. Ahel uses only providers that fit under it, and when none does the run is refused with nothing run or charged. One run only; a list has its own quote and confirm.

wait_seconds.description: Optional: how long to wait for the run to finish and answer its rows here, 0-50 seconds. Default 20; 0 answers the execution id at once. A list waits up to 45 s.

idempotency_key.description: Optional: your own key for this run, 8 to 200 letters, digits, dots, underscores, colons or hyphens. Sending the same call again with the same key answers the same run with no new charge; the same key with different inputs is refused.

tag.description: Optional: a label for this run, such as the customer or project it is for: 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores. Activity shows runs and cost by tag. It stays in Ahel and is never sent to a provider.

rows.description: A list for people.email.find or companies.register.search or companies.emails.from_website: 1 to 100 rows, each run once as its own run with its own exact cost. One object per row, such as {"name": "Jane Doe", "domain": "example.com"} or {"name": "Example Ltd", "country": "GB"}.

rows_text.description: A list for people.email.find or companies.register.search or companies.emails.from_website: 1 to 100 rows, each run once as its own run with its own exact cost. Instead of rows: paste up to 100 rows as text, one per line ("Jane Doe, example.com"; "Example Ltd, GB") or a CSV with a header row (name, domain, linkedin_url; name, country).

confirm.description: With rows or rows_text: true runs the list once the person agrees to its quote. Left out, the answer is the quote and nothing runs. The same list sent again the same UTC day answers the first run's receipt and neither runs nor charges again; a new idempotency_key runs it again.

run_id.description: With id: the run_id a list's receipt answered, to read its rows still running and start the rest. Rows already run are never run twice.

tools.name: run_recipe
tools.title: Run a ready-made recipe
tools.description: Run a recipe: a ready-made job of several actions, such as local businesses of one kind in one place with their emails (or only those with weak reviews), new companies with contacts or companies with a reason to call now in any country (contracts, new registrations, funding or hiring, with a signal date, the person to reach and checked emails; Estonia adds year-on-year tax figures), a visibility report for a website (country, language, questions and optional competitors), a company list with industry, size and register entry, checked work emails for a list of people, a brief on a company and a person before a sales call, a pitch or an interview, with optional news and public posts, or companies that just raised money, use a named tool or won a public contract, each with the person to reach and a checked work email, or the social media accounts of one kind of business in one place, with when each started and how many followers it has. Visibility accepts English country/language names or codes. Reason-to-call groups Estonian contract lines by company and defaults to a 1,000 euro company total floor (minimum: 0 disables it). For emails with TikTok, include Instagram; TikTok returns no website. The first choice for a person who is not a developer. Without id: the list of recipes and their inputs. With id and inputs: the price of the whole job and a consent sentence; nothing runs. With max_cost_usd as well (once the person agrees): it runs under that total and answers the rows; a longer run answers a run_id, and run_id reads on. Only delivered results are charged. NOT for: one action alone, which is run_capability.

id.description: A recipe id from this tool's own list, such as company-list. Left out, the answer is the list.

inputs.description: The recipe's inputs, by name, as its entry in the list names them.

max_cost_usd.description: The most the whole run may cost, in USD, such as "0.50". Left out, the answer is the price and nothing runs.

run_id.description: With id: the run_id an earlier call answered, to read that run.

idempotency_key.description: Optional: your own key for this run, 8 to 64 letters, digits or hyphens. It becomes the run_id.
